summary: Round 3 passes. Each FIX item is fixed and has a test that fails on the old code. The path class of preview.sh has no gap that writes under docs. Three minor items and one nit remain.
nonblocking_findings: A3-1 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:75-93: The new order (docs copy, then real-work.ts) changes the refusal rule for an existing preview folder. An input-check refusal now leaves the docs copy inside a folder that already existed (I saw 7 entries after a `input-check: manifest` refusal; the old order left it unchanged). For a new nested folder, `rm -rf` removes only the leaf, so the parents made by `mkdir -p` remain (/tmp/ra3/pv3/deep stayed). The header text `leaves no new preview folder` is true only for the leaf. The F19 test checks only the leaf. No docs write results, and publish refuses on a SHA mismatch, so the failure is safe. Fix: run real-work.ts into a temp folder first, or record the first created parent and remove it.

A3-2 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:180-183: The F17 fix checks that each coverage key is present, but not its type. A coverage value that is null, a number in a date field, or a string in a share field passes the input check. preview.sh then raises a Python traceback and exits 1 (I ran three modified exports with a matching manifest: TypeError, AttributeError, and ValueError). The preview folder stays half built, with the docs copy, real-work.json, and preview-base.json but no real-work.html. This is the non-numeric part of C2-6, and the header promise of exit 0 or exit 2 does not hold for it. The risk is low because the PM export is manifest-checked. Publish refuses without an approved real-work.html. Fix: check the types of the six keys in the schema check and refuse with `input-check: schema`.

A3-3 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:80-87: A symlink inside an existing preview folder can send a write under docs. In a temp copy of HEAD, I planted `<preview>/real-work.json -> <repo>/docs/real-work.json` (dangling), and preview.sh exited 0 and created `<repo>/docs/real-work.json` through the link. This is outside the path class of the --preview and --export values, because it needs a link planted in an existing folder, and the old code had the same gap. I rate it Minor, not Blocker, for that reason. The orchestrator may decide otherwise. Fix: refuse when `find "$PREVIEW_ABS" -type l` prints a line, or remove the five output names before the write.

A3-4 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:107-113: The nav insert is not idempotent. When docs/index.html already holds the Real work and Review links (after the first publish), a new preview adds the same links again (I counted 2 links in a temp copy). Phase 1 builds the first preview only, so the gate is not affected. The update flow of D19 will meet it. Fix: skip the insert when the link text is present.

Path class check (focus 2): I ran preview.sh in a temp copy of HEAD with the fixture export. The matrix had 7 caller folders (repo root, harness, harness/model-guide, docs, docs/existsub, a folder outside, and /) and 31 --preview values (docs, docs/, docs/., docs/existsub, docs/newsub, ../docs, ../../docs, ../../../docs, ., .., ../.., /, //, /., /.., the absolute docs path with trailing slash, double slash, and `..` segment, the repo root with and without a slash, a symlink to docs with and without a child, a dangling symlink to docs/newsub with and without a child, a symlink to the repo with docs and docs/zz, a symlink to the repo, a symlink to /, and /home through a symlink). Each refused value gave exit 2 and a docs snapshot (find list plus SHA-256 of each file) equal to the one before. No run changed the docs folder. Each allowed value resolved to a folder outside docs. `docs/newsub` was never created. Relative --export values resolve from the caller folder (test F14 and the matrix both gave exit 0).
